notes_for_editor: Only one source describes the tower itself: a 1953 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description reproduced on Central US Lookouts. No build date, builder, staffing, fire history or current status was found, so the story starts from the 1953 description. The 2022 campground article is about the state park unit and does not mention the lookout; the story does not link the two. The brief's status and access remain unknown. Confidence low.
